OpenEUICC is not running as a system app

OpenEUICC is running as a normal app instead of a privileged system app, so it cannot access the eUICC.

This usually means the Magisk / KernelSU module was not mounted. If an older version of this module (or hzy132’s module) ever ran `pm install`, a leftover copy in /data/app can also shadow the system app.

How to fix:
1. Reboot once. The module now removes a stale /data/app copy automatically on boot.
2. If that does not help, open Diagnostics (overflow menu) and check the "File /system/priv-app/..." lines. If the APK is missing, the module is not mounted: change the mount mode, or install a mount helper such as mountify.
3. A boot report is written to /data/local/tmp/openeuicc-boot.log.

Open the app again once it runs as a system app.
